subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin support opt-in all-message Space ingestion, and should that use user OAuth, Google Workspace Events/Pub/Sub, or stay out of scope for now?
rationale: The remaining work changes credential storage, Google consent/scopes, non-mentioned Space message visibility, operator setup, and event-subscription lifecycle; source review can prove the gap but cannot choose that security boundary.

options.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
options.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events contract, preserve service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

options.title: Keep Service-Account Mentioned Webhooks
options.body: Leave Google Chat limited to @mentioned webhook events and close or narrow all-message ingestion as out of scope while maintaining thread-reply reliability.

options.title: Defer To Broader Workspace Auth
options.body: Hold the feature until Google Workspace integrations share a common consent, token, Pub/Sub, and admin-approval model.

recommendation.title: Approve Plugin-Local OAuth/Events Design
recommendation.body: Define a SecretRef-aware Google Chat user OAuth or Workspace Events contract, preserve service-account webhook behavior, and implement all-message ingestion behind explicit operator configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent combination of Google Chat auth/API history and prior review context for the OAuth/security boundary.
